tagline: react-data-grid is a fast, Excel-like data grid for React, MIT-licensed.
oneLineVerdict: react-data-grid is a strong, lightweight React grid with great editing. SvGrid is the Svelte-5-native equivalent, with a similar feature set and no React dependency.
alternativeIntro: react-data-grid is React-only, so this is a port rather than a swap, and the shapes line up well: both are Excel-like, both MIT, both driven by column definitions. Cell renderers become Svelte snippets and hooks become runes. If you are staying on React, there is no reason to move.
intro: react-data-grid (the adazzle project) is a focused, performant React grid known for spreadsheet-style editing, virtualization, and a clean column API. It is MIT-licensed and React-only.
SvGrid offers the same shape - virtualized DOM, typed columns, inline editing, custom cells - built on Svelte 5 runes and snippets rather than React components.
svgridAdvantages: Svelte 5 native - runes and snippets, not React.
Built-in Excel-style filter menu and the imperative API.
Grouping, tree data, and master/detail in the core.
competitorAdvantages: First-class fit for a React codebase.
Mature, focused, and battle-tested in React apps.

competitor.note: cell copy, paste and value dragging

whenToChooseSvGrid: You are on Svelte 5 rather than React.
You want filters, grouping, and master/detail without building them.
You want a headless engine option and an MCP server.
whenToChooseCompetitor: Your app is React and you want a focused, proven grid.
You want the React community and ecosystem around it.
You only need the feature set react-data-grid already covers.

youLose: A very small React grid with the spreadsheet basics built in.
React 19 features such as the use hook in cell renderers.

pricing.summary: react-data-grid is MIT on npm and free; no licence is sold

bottomLine: react-data-grid is a strong, focused choice in React. On Svelte 5, SvGrid is the equivalent - similar editing and virtualization - plus a built-in filter menu, grouping, and a headless core, with no React dependency.

faq.question: SvGrid vs react-data-grid - which for Svelte?
faq.answer: SvGrid - it is Svelte-5-native, while react-data-grid is React-only. They share a similar editing and virtualization model.

faq.question: Does SvGrid have built-in filtering unlike react-data-grid?
faq.answer: Yes - SvGrid ships an Excel-style filter menu and a global filter; react-data-grid leaves the filter UI to you.

faq.question: Is SvGrid free like react-data-grid?
faq.answer: Yes, the core is MIT. SvGrid adds an optional Enterprise pack for export, import, pivot, and AI.

sources.evidences: React 19.2+; virtualization of rows and columns, multi-column sorting, cell editing, row grouping and a TreeDataGrid, frozen columns, cell copy and paste, cell value dragging; light and dark mode through color-scheme
